title: IsdaMasterCalculationAgentEnum
description: The enumerated values to specify who the calculation agent in the ISDA Master Agreement.

oneOf.title: Demands_4c
oneOf.description: Party making the demand for the purposes of Paragraphs 3, 4(c) and 5 and the Secured Party for the purposes of Paragraph 4(d)

oneOf.title: Demands_4d
oneOf.description: Party making the demand for the purposes of Paragraphs 3, 4(d) and 5 and the Secured Party for the purposes of Paragraph 4(e )

oneOf.title: Party_A_Or_Party_B
oneOf.description: Party A or Party B, as applicable
